result.title: Design Anything, Design at Scale
result.comment: 47 pages, 25 figures, 16 tables. Project page: https://designanything.gemus.ai
result.summary: As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons. Designers follow briefs specifying goals, constraints, and deliverables, with later work building on earlier decisions. Recent work reuses design experience across tasks, yet alignment among artifacts within one project remains challenging. Agents therefore need to preserve and apply this intent across domains and as projects grow. We introduce Design Anything, a graph-based harness that preserves design intent outside the model and binds deliverables to the workflow steps that produce them through an intent-execution graph. A task contract retains constraints and decisions, selected designs become explicit inputs to later generations, and a deterministic controller uses bindings and execution records to check output types and counts, identify outstanding deliverables, and guide subsequent turns. We also introduce DesignAnything-Bench, with 228 tasks across 19 design domains, including 38 project families at scales of 6, 14, and 24 artifacts. With the LLM held fixed, Design Anything satisfies 85.0% and 92.5% of the brief's factual constraints with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High and GPT-5.6 Sol High, respectively, exceeding the strongest same-model baselines by 15.4% and 14.4%. These gains reach 25.1% and 23.0% on 24-artifact tasks. Under each model, Design Anything leads or ties in constraint satisfaction in 18 of 19 domains. Professional designers also prefer its complete deliverable sets over those of same-model baselines in a blind evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Design Anything，一种基于图的框架，把设计意图外化为「意图—执行图」，用确定性控制器检查输出类型与数量、识别未完成的交付物并引导后续轮次，同时发布覆盖 19 个设计领域、228 个任务的 DesignAnything-Bench 来评测长程多产物设计的约束满足。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把意图与执行记录外化到模型之外、并用确定性控制器判断任务是否完成并决定后续轮次的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的外部化表示、证据核查与停止决策提供对照线索，但对象是设计产物而非视觉推理状态，联系需核查。
